subject: Invoice enablement & tax forms for AcroHealth - kickoff
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana López <ana.lopez@acrohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice enablement & tax forms for AcroHealth - kickoff

Hi Ana —

Welcome — we're excited to get AcroHealth set up so your invoices can be paid cleanly by our AP team. To get started I need a few items from your side so Procurement can create a PO and Accounts Payable can enable your vendor code:

Checklist (please return within 3 business days if possible):
- Signed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if foreign) — PDF preferred
- VAT registration certificate (if you collect VAT)
- Legal company name and DBA (if different)
- Remittance / billing address and preferred invoice email
- TIN/EIN (you can redact all but last 4 digits on a copy if needed; AP will need full TIN on file)
- Preferred payment terms (net30/net45) and bank remittance instructions (if you want ACH)
- Sample invoice showing line item format and PO reference (we require the PO number on the invoice)

I've attached a short Vendor Intake form and a link to our shared folder for secure upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xVENDOR_INTAKE_FORM
We also have a standard vendor agreement that requires signature — I'll send the DocuSign once we've confirmed the tax docs.

If anything on the checklist is going to take longer, let me know and we can prioritize the minimum needed to create a PO.

Thanks,

Olga Petrov
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (fillable), Redwood_PO_instructions.pdf
From: Ana López <ana.lopez@acrohealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acrohealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice enablement & tax forms for AcroHealth - kickoff

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attached are the items we can provide today:
- AcroHealth_W9_signed.pdf (signed W-9)
- AcroHealth_BANK_DETAILS.csv (bank name and ACH instructions)

A couple of quick questions:
1) AcroHealth is a US entity, so W-9 is correct — we included our EIN on the form. If AP needs the full TIN in a secure channel, please advise.
2) We do not collect VAT (US-based). Not applicable for us.
3) What PO format should we expect? Will the PO come from procurement@redwoodinference.com or a vendor-portal?
4) Do you require a signed vendor agreement before the first invoice or can we submit invoices against the PO and sign after?

We prefer net30 payment terms. Please confirm invoice submission email and any PO number format so we can populate our invoice template.

Best,
Ana López
Director of Finance Ops
AcroHealth
ana.lopez@acrohealth.com
+1 (617) 555-0198

Attachments: AcroHealth_W9_signed.pdf, AcroHealth_BANK_DETAILS.csv

Hi Ana —

Thanks — I confirm receipt of the signed W-9 and the ACH info. I've uploaded the W-9 to our secure vendor folder and flagged the bank file for AP to review. For the TIN, the copy you sent is fine for intake; AP may request the unredacted TIN via secure channel when they finalize payee setup.

Next steps from our side:
- Procurement (Karthik) will create PO and send it to you — please use the PO number on the invoice.
- I'll send the DocuSign vendor agreement link today so legal has a signed copy on file.
- AP will enable your vendor code and confirm remittance address; please expect an enablement email from ap@redwoodinference.com once complete.

Payment terms: we can confirm net30. If you need net45, let me know and I can escalate.

If you can reply with the billing address to match on the PO (street, city, zip), we can push the PO through today.

Olga

Attachments: (none)
